layout_note: True matrix face: one page (PDF p.78, printed p.76) holds both the 2024 and 2025 movement blocks. Block 1 opens at the December 31, 2023 balance, includes the January 01, 2024 accounting-policy change as a movement, and treats the as-restated January 01, 2024 balance as a displayed subtotal (not a movement) so the roll-forward is not double-counted. Block 2 opens from block 1's closing balance, includes the January 01, 2025 policy change as a movement, and likewise treats the as-restated January 01, 2025 balance as a subtotal. The total-comprehensive-income and total-distributions rows carry no printed label and are recorded as bare subtotals. The statement of comprehensive income (PDF p.77) is NOT a separate face here, matching the Phase 7 four-face scope (SFP, P&L, CF, CE).
